versions.content: Support UDS service $38 (RequestFileTransfer) Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall support UDS service 0x38 ("RequestFileTransfer”). Rationale: The requestFileTransfer service is used by the client to initiate a file data transfer from either the client to the server or from the server to the client (download or upload). Additionally, this service has capabilities to retrieve information about the file system Use Case: Upload of files (e.g. data files, graphics, navigation data...) AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Supporting Material: ISO 14229-1 v.2013
